register_extended_coco_dataset: register a COCO dataset split with image directory and annotation JSON file to DatasetCatalog
register_extended_lvis_dataset: register an LVIS dataset split with image directory and annotation JSON file to DatasetCatalog
register_coco_text_dataset: register a COCO text dataset split with source JSON and image directory to DatasetCatalog
inject_coco_datasets: inject multiple COCO datasets from config with names, image dirs, and JSON files using a registered function
register_json_datasets: discover and register all JSON dataset splits from the d2go.datasets module directory
